project_type: ADX compiler — a single npm package (name: adx) rooted at the worktree root; compile-to-vanilla frontend framework. TypeScript, ESM, no runtime deps.
language: TypeScript 5.7 (ESM, NodeNext module resolution — imports use .js extensions pointing at .ts sources)
build_system: tsc (tsconfig.json at root). `npm run build` = `tsc -p tsconfig.json` emits to dist/. The CLI bin is dist/cli.js. The published `files` allowlist is [dist, tokens, README.md] — benchmark/ and jsdom must stay OUT of it (dev-only).
test_framework: Vitest 2.1.8. Suites live in test/ and mirror src/. `npm test` = `vitest run`.
verification_instructions: After each feature run `npm run build` (must be tsc-clean) then `npm test` (all suites green). Baseline before any change: 77 tests across 11 files pass, tsc clean. For DOM-dependent features (hydration parity, per-instance glue, reactivity) add jsdom as a devDependency and run the emitted glue string under a jsdom DOM inside Vitest. The SEO contract is verified by asserting the raw emitted HTML (pre-JS) contains resolved content and zero '{{'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: No committed build artifacts. dist/ and node_modules/ are gitignored. benchmark/run.ts compiles to dist/benchmark/run.js via tsc and writes benchmark/results.json at runtime (results.json is a generated output; decide whether to gitignore or commit a sample — keep it reproducible via `npm run benchmark`).
environment_constraints: Work ONLY inside the worktree root .worktrees/adx-m2 — relative paths otherwise land in the parent workspace. Node >=18. The node:vm sandbox is NOT a hard security boundary (documented limit). All compiler errors MUST use the exact format `[ADX] <file>:<line> - <message>` (manifest/page/behavior errors are line-less: `[ADX] <file> - <message>`); tests assert these verbatim, so never reorder/re-space.
contribution_requirements: Steering (.kiro/steering/*) is mandatory: token-first output; SEO static-first (complete HTML at build time, zero '{{' left, glue only hydrates); design tokens via semantic token names, no hardcoded values; docs are part of definition-of-done and must be synced in the same change, marking only what actually works as shipped (planned vs real). Keep docs in the existing voice (compact/reference for agent-facing docs/agent-reference.md + docs/adx-grammar.md; warm for README.md + docs/human-guide.md).
key_patterns: Errors: use adxError(file,line,msg) / adxFileError(file,msg) from src/errors.ts — never hand-format. Behavior scan is name-only (src/behavior/scan.ts, EXPORT_RE classifies setup / on<Event> / get<Name> / lifecycle). The expr evaluator (src/expr/evaluate.ts) resolves a bare ident loop->state->props->computed, where computed is keyed by BARE name (displayName for getDisplayName). scopeId(name, locationPath) in src/codegen/scope.ts hashes `name\u0000locationPath` VERBATIM (no normalization — the CALLER must pass a stable, repo-relative, POSIX-normalized path for composed/page children; single-component M1 path keeps basename(dir)). bindingId(scope,n)=`${scope}-${n}`. The glue reads globalThis.__ADX_PROPS__ (NOT window). The HTML emitter stamps data-adx-c=scopeId on owned elements and data-adx-b on bound/evented nodes. splitAttributes in src/structure/parser.ts imposes NO charset on plain attribute names, so `<template slot="x">` and `<template #x>` both already parse (PROP_NAME only guards ':' bindings and '@' events). parseSlot takes the first bare attribute as the slot name; `<slot name="actions"/>` ERRORS (valued attr).
relevant_files: src/compile.ts — compileComponent/checkComponent entry; defaultProps; wrapDocument (M1 SEO); build scope is currently {state:defaults, props:defaults}, setup() NOT executed
src/cli.ts — parseArgs (--out/--tokens pattern to mirror for --data); build writes <out>/<basename>/{index.html,style.css,glue.js,behavior.js}

src/codegen/html.ts — emitHtml -> {html,hooks}; BindingHook{id,events,bindings}; emitElement stamps data-adx-c/data-adx-b; emitSlot emits data-adx-slot placeholder; custom tags currently emitted verbatim
src/codegen/glue.ts — emitGlue: single root querySelector([data-adx-c]), single setup(props), buildProps=manifest defaults only, globalThis.__ADX_PROPS__ override; NO patch path yet
src/codegen/scope.ts — scopeId (verbatim hash) + bindingId; add instanceBindingId here (additive)
src/codegen/context.ts — CodegenContext {componentName,scopeId,scope,tokens,behavior,manifest}; extend with mergedProps + INSTANCES accumulator + instance-ordinal counter
src/codegen/css.ts — transformCss scopes every selector by [data-adx-c=id]; reused as-is for isolation
src/behavior/scan.ts — scanBehavior -> BehaviorApi{hasSetup,events,computed,lifecycle,other,all}; EXPORT_RE to reuse for the sandbox export-strip
src/behavior/types.ts — BehaviorApi
src/expr/evaluate.ts — evaluate/truthy/toText; EvalScope{locals,state,props,computed}; the runtime glue evalExpr must mirror this ident/member walk
src/structure/ast.ts — Node/ElementNode/SlotNode/TextNode/Expr/Binding/TextPart; Expr is {kind:'ident'} | {kind:'member',object,property}
src/structure/parser.ts — parseSlot (bare-attr name), splitAttributes (no charset), PROP_NAME guards only :/@
src/manifest/load.ts + src/manifest/types.ts — Manifest{name,version,props,emits,slots,deps,seo}; deps:string[] validated; PropDef{type,required?,default?}; SeoMeta{title?,description?,schema?}
src/tokens/load.ts — loadTokens(path); DEFAULT_TOKENS = tokens/design-tokens.json
src/errors.ts — AdxError, adxError, adxFileError, formatError (the [ADX] contract)
src/index.ts — public re-exports; add new modules here

fixtures/user-card/{manifest.json,structure.adx,behavior.adx.js,style.adx.css} — the golden fixture; `name` is required with NO default (so required-prop validation will change its standalone compile result — design Risk 6)
test/compile.test.ts, test/seo-contract.test.ts — currently compile the fixture WITHOUT data and expect success; MUST be updated to supply data for the required `name`
test/helpers.ts — fixtureDir, tokensPath, makeCtx(overrides) (note makeCtx scope.state already supplies name='Ada Lovelace')
test/html-emit.test.ts, test/glue-emit.test.ts — will need updates when hook ids become `${scope}-i0-${n}` and glue becomes per-instance
.agents/tasks/m2-design.md — the APPROVED design (revision 3); authoritative for every mechanism and every exact error string
docs/roadmap.md, docs/adx-grammar.md, docs/agent-reference.md, docs/human-guide.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/comparison.md, docs/token-efficiency.md, README.md — doc-sync targets (FEAT-006)
directory_structure: src/ holds the compiler (cli.ts, compile.ts, structure/, manifest/, behavior/, tokens/, expr/, codegen/, errors.ts, source.ts, index.ts). test/ mirrors src/ with Vitest suites + helpers.ts. fixtures/user-card/ is the golden four-file component. tokens/design-tokens.json is the token source. docs/ holds the agent + human references. .agents/tasks/ holds workflow artifacts (m2-design.md, plan.md, and these FEAT files). New M2 code adds: src/behavior/compute-key.ts, src/behavior/run.ts, src/page/{types.ts,load.ts,compile.ts}, src/codegen/html-tags.ts, optional src/codegen/compose.ts, fixtures/site/ (page manifests + site-header), benchmark/.
